entities.summary: Allen Bernard Hurns is an American former professional football player who was a wide receiver in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Miami Hurricanes and was signed by the Jacksonville Jaguars as an undrafted free agent in 2014. Hurns also played for the Dallas Cowboys and Miami Dolphins.
